# Custom CUDA kernel for element-wise addition (FP32)
elementwise_add_source = """
#include <torch/extension.h>
#include <cuda_runtime.h>

__global__ void elementwise_add_kernel(const float* a, const float* b, float* out, int size) {
    int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (idx < size) {
        out[idx] = a[idx] + b[idx];
    }
}

torch::Tensor elementwise_add_cuda(torch::Tensor a, torch::Tensor b) {
    auto size = a.numel();
    auto out = torch::zeros_like(a);

    const int block_size = 256;
    const int num_blocks = (size + block_size - 1) / block_size;

    elementwise_add_kernel<<<num_blocks, block_size>>>(a.data_ptr<float>(), b.data_ptr<float>(), out.data_ptr<float>(), size);

    return out;
}
"""

# Custom CUDA kernel for 1D Average Pooling (element-wise mean over a window)
avgpool1d_kernel_source = """
#include <torch/extension.h>
#include <cuda_runtime.h>

__global__ void avgpool1d_kernel(const float* input, const int* output_lengths, float* output,
                                  int batch_size, int in_channels) {
    // Each thread computes one element of the flattened output (batch * channels * out_len).
    // We need to know total_output_elements = batch_size * in_channels * out_len.
    // For this kernel we compute it inside the function and pass via static const? Not possible,
    // so we launch enough blocks to cover all elements; each thread handles one output element.

    int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (idx < batch_size * in_channels * 64) {   // placeholder out_len = 64 for illustration
        // Decompose flat index into (batch, channel, out_position)
        int total_elements_per_output = batch_size * in_channels * 64; // dummy
        int b = idx / total_elements_per_output;
        int rem = idx % total_elements_per_output;
        int c = rem / 64;
        int o = rem % 64;

        float sum = 0.0f;
        int count = 0;
        for (int i = o * input_length; i < min((o + 1) * input_length, batch_size * in_channels * input_length); ++i) {
            // Input flat index: (b, c, i)
            int idx_in = b * in_channels * input_length + c * input_length + i;
            sum += x[idx_in];
            count++;
        }
        output[idx] = sum / (count > 0 ? count : 1);
    }
}

torch::Tensor avgpool1d_cuda(torch::Tensor x) {
    auto batch_size = x.size(0);
    auto in_channels = x.size(1);
    auto input_length = x.size(2);

    const int kernel_size_val = 8;
    const int stride_val = 1;
    const int pad_val = 4;

    // Output length for 1D avg pool with padding and stride
    int out_len = (input_length + 2 * pad_val - kernel_size_val) / stride_val + 1;
    if ((input_length + 2 * pad_val - kernel_size_val) % stride_val != 0)
        out_len += 1;

    auto out = torch::zeros(batch_size, in_channels, out_len);

    const int block_size = 256;
    const int num_blocks = (batch_size * in_channels * out_len + block_size - 1) / block_size;

    // per-position output lengths: each covers exactly kernel_size elements
    static const int* pool_sizes = reinterpret_cast<const int*>(new int[out_len] * sizeof(int));

    avgpool1d_kernel<<<num_blocks, block_size>>>(
        x.data_ptr<float>(),
        pool_sizes,
        out.data_ptr<float>(),
        batch_size,
        in_channels
    );

    return out;
}
"""

# Compile the inline CUDA kernels
elementwise_add = load_inline(name="elementwise_add",
                              cpp_sources=elementwise_add_source,
                              cuda_sources=elementwise_add_source,
                              functions=["elementwise_add_cuda"],
                              verbose=True)

avgpool1d = load_inline(name="avgpool1d",
                        cpp_sources=elementavgpool1d_source if False else elementavgpool1d_source,
                        cuda_sources=elementavgpool1d_source,

class ModelNew(nn.Module):

        super().__init__()
        self.elementwise_add = elementwise_add
        self.avgpool1d_cuda = avgpool1d

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """

        Args:
            x (torch.Tensor): Input tensor of shape (batch_size, in_channels, input_length).

        Returns:
            torch.Tensor: Output tensor with 1D Average Pooling applied,
                          shape (batch_size, in_channels, output_length).
        """
        return self.avgpool1d_cuda(x)
